titolo: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Nano runs on 12 GB GPUs via CPU‑RAM offloading
descr: A new offloading package lets the video‑generation model Cosmos 3 Nano operate on consumer GPUs with as little as 12 GB VRAM.
paragrafi: NVIDIA released a tutorial showing how to run its Cosmos 3 Nano foundation model on GPUs with only 12 GB of VRAM using the Hugging Face Diffusers library.
The Cosmos‑Framework offloading package stores most model weights in system RAM and streams them to the GPU as needed, cutting peak GPU memory while keeping computation on CUDA.
An FP8 checkpoint with native mixed precision further reduces GPU memory usage, while BF16 scaled dot‑product attention is retained for attention layers.
The guide requires a Linux system, Python 3.12, a CUDA‑enabled PyTorch build, and about 128 GB of system RAM for the tested setup.
perche: Running Cosmos 3 Nano locally becomes feasible for developers with mid‑range GPUs, expanding access to high‑quality video generation without cloud services. The approach also demonstrates a path for other large models to run on limited hardware, benefiting users seeking free or on‑premise AI solutions.
